decision: named it Flotsam: keeps the big files that float past while you browse
why: short, unclaimed on GitHub under tretuttle, says what it does
evidence: gh repo view tretuttle/flotsam -> not found

decision: recorder core is a Firefox experiment API paired with an extension.js extension
why: experiment APIs are the one extension mechanism that runs code with the system principal in the parent process, and only the declaring extension can call it
evidence: Zen AddonSettings.sys.mjs:104 EXPERIMENTS_ENABLED follows pref because MOZ_REQUIRE_SIGNING=false (AppConstants.sys.mjs:113)

decision: Gecko-family only for the recorder (Zen, Firefox Nightly/Dev Edition/unbranded, forks without forced signing)
why: Chromium has no parent-process extension hook; chrome.debugger shows a banner on every tab, which breaks always-on

decision: toolchain copied from parkpal-monorepo, which copies t3code
why: user named both as the guardrails to follow

decision: parent script is bundled to one readable IIFE after extension build, not copied through public/
why: extension.js production builds minify every copied script, and the privileged script should ship readable
evidence: dist/firefox/experiment/parent.js was 0.84 KB minified via public/ vs 1.5 KB readable via scripts/build-experiment.ts

decision: schema.json is generated from the typed API contract table
why: Gecko async functions cannot declare a result schema (Schemas.sys.mjs FunctionType.parseSchema), so the result type lives in TypeScript and both sides typecheck against one table
evidence: planted table/parent/popup drift each failed effect-tsgo typecheck

decision: real-browser proof drives Marionette against a fresh profile and installs the packed XPI permanently
why: Marionette Addon:Install with temporary:false is the same AddonManager path as Install Add-on From File; application.ini is independent ground truth
evidence: scripts/verify-zen.ts passed 10 checks on zen-stock 1.25t; a planted toolbox bug failed 2
